rules.short_original_anchor: Chap LXXI Woman of husband at Sea
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The chapter concerns a wife asking about an absent husband traveling by sea.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: New worked case, distinct from preceding spouse mortality case.

rules.short_original_anchor: original square horoscope
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Lilly prints a separate square horary figure.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No independent modern ephemeris parity.

rules.short_original_anchor: 15 April 1645 1:10 PM
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The chart center gives 15 April 1645 at 1:10 PM.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Source time convention unverified.

rules.short_original_anchor: alive where and when return
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The user question asks about status, location and return of absent husband.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Alive, location, hearing news and reunion are distinct outcomes.

rules.short_original_anchor: Mercury Lord ascendant signifies querent
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Mercury is assigned to the wife/questioner.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Distinct from Jupiter representing husband.

rules.short_original_anchor: Mercury conjunction Moon and Saturn Aries
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Mercury, Moon and Saturn are invoked in the querent description.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Printed source text exact house glyphs have not been independently checked.

rules.short_original_anchor: face disfigured by smallpox, weak eyes
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Lilly reports wife with smallpox marks and weak eyesight.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Source-internal subjective claim, no independent record.

rules.short_original_anchor: much grief and sorrow for husband
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: He alleges deep concern for the absent husband.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Her question itself reveals concern; not blind inference.

rules.short_original_anchor: lisping and ill speech
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The author attributes a speech impediment to the wife.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No independent witness or medical validation.

rules.short_original_anchor: Jupiter Lord seventh in tenth
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Jupiter is assigned as the husband significator and located in tenth.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Seventh-house derivation essential.

rules.short_original_anchor: Jupiter lately separated sextile Venus in ninth
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The source cites a recent favorable Jupiter-Venus aspect.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Separation refers to the recent past, not a future prediction.

rules.short_original_anchor: Venus Lady third
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Venus is described as ruler of third.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Part of his travel inference; not an unrelated natal fact.

rules.short_original_anchor: lately some voyage South-east
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The source infers an earlier journey toward southeast.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Same-author retrospective claim, not independently verified.

rules.short_original_anchor: Jupiter swift and not afflicted
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Jupiter is judged swift and free of affliction.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Other weakness appears on next page; do not claim unconditionally strong.

rules.short_original_anchor: man was alive and in health
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Lilly initially concludes the absent man was living and healthy.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No independent person status verification.

rules.short_original_anchor: Mercury disposes Jupiter, Lord second eighth from seventh
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Mercury is described as disposer and ruler of eighth from the husband derived first.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Do not replace derived eighth with radical eighth.

rules.short_original_anchor: Moon exceedingly afflicted by Mercury and Saturn
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The Moon is associated with adverse planets in the wife concern.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Exact aspects and time sequence not independently recomputed.

rules.short_original_anchor: man had been in danger by treachery
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Lilly infers a recent threatening experience involving other people.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Unverified accusation against unnamed adversaries.

rules.short_original_anchor: many afflictions during absence
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: He supposes the man experienced many hardships.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No external logs of voyage or captivity supplied.

rules.short_original_anchor: Mercury Lord seventh from husbands ascendant
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Mercury is recast as ruler of seventh derived from husband.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Derived significator differs from wife role in main chart.

rules.short_original_anchor: Saturn twelfth from seventh
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Saturn is assigned as derived twelfth of absent husband.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Period symbolism, not verification of imprisonment.

rules.short_original_anchor: Jupiter accidentally fortified, not essentially, detriment
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Jupiter is described as accidentally stronger but essentially debilitated.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Do not discard essential detriment because of accidental strength.

rules.short_original_anchor: with Oculus fixed Star
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: A fixed star called Oculus is cited with Jupiter.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No independent stellar longitude/aspect parity.

rules.short_original_anchor: many sudden and violent chances
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Lilly interprets the combination as turbulent experiences.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Source-only and retrospectively flexible.

rules.short_original_anchor: Jupiter more fortified than Moon
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Jupiter receives priority over Moon for travel direction.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Comparative strength judgment uncalibrated.

rules.short_original_anchor: Mercury Southerly Sign, Jupiter Gemini West, south quarter
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The author combines planet/sign and heaven-quarter directional testimonies.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Do not infer a unique numeric compass bearing.

rules.short_original_anchor: South-west England, some Harbour
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: He judges the husband was in southwestern England in a harbor.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No independently dated location proof before feedback.

rules.short_original_anchor: Jupiter angular
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: An angular placement is invoked as support for a settled location.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Historically source-native interpretation.

rules.short_original_anchor: Moon separates Saturn, applies conjunction Mercury
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: A Moon movement from Saturn toward wife-significator Mercury is the timing premise.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Separation and applying conjunction are distinct.

rules.short_original_anchor: hear of husband in two or three days
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: He predicts first news within two to three days.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Hearing news is not physical reunion.

rules.short_original_anchor: Moon distance one degree, Sign movable
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: He cites roughly one-degree gap and movable-sign character for timing.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: A mapping from zodiac degrees to days is asserted, not independently calibrated.

rules.short_original_anchor: so she did hear
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Lilly says she did hear something within the short window.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Source self-report, no dated letter or witness.

rules.short_original_anchor: first report husband in Town false
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The early rumor was that he was in town but was mistaken.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: A genuine report can be FALSE concerning husband location, not a true location success.

rules.short_original_anchor: Mercury and Jupiter hasten conjunction Gemini
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: A future joining between wife and husband significators is used.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Source describes the predicted geometry, no ephemeris parity.

rules.short_original_anchor: conjunction fifth of May, certain news or home
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: Lilly predicts definite news at about 5 May or possible return.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Different date and endpoints than the earlier rumor.

rules.short_original_anchor: second week May heard certain news
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The woman reportedly received reliable news during second week of May.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Later than exactly May 5; self-reported and not independent.

rules.short_original_anchor: no actual return until second week July
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The husband reportedly returned only in the second week of July.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: A return in July is not an on-time May reunion.

rules.short_original_anchor: several Voyages West parts
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The source states he made several voyages in western England.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Historical source narrative only.

rules.short_original_anchor: taken Prisoner Kings Forces
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: It reports detention by Royalist forces.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No independent military detention evidence supplied.

rules.short_original_anchor: at time of Question was at Barnstable
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: The author later locates him at Barnstable (Barnstaple) at query time.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: No authenticated original location document or neutral adjudication.

rules.short_original_anchor: CHAP LXXII Canterbury manner of death
rules.historical_author_report_paraphrase: A new numbered Archbishop of Canterbury case begins on printed419.
rules.conditions_original_uncertainty: Navigation-only; its separate 3 December 1644 horoscope not imported.
